ἀναγραμματ-ίζω ,
A.write the letters of a name in direct and then in reverse order,
PMag.Leid.W. 3.21 ( Pass. ), al.
II. transpose the letters of one word so as to form another,
Eust. 46.2 , 488.12 ( Pass. ); e. g. Ἥρα ἀήρ, ἀρετή ἐρατή, Ἀρσινόη ἴον Ἥρας, Πτολεμαῖος ἀπὸ μέλιτος.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
